=== Dockerfile ===
FROM python:3.12.6-alpine as builder

ARG INDEX_URL

# Copy the current directory contents into the container at /app
COPY ./src /app/src
COPY main.py /app


# Set the working directory to /app
WORKDIR /app

# Install dependencies
COPY requirements.txt requirements.txt
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir wheel
RUN if [ -n "${INDEX_URL:-}" ]; then \
        pip install --no-cache-dir --extra-index-url "$INDEX_URL" -r requirements.txt; \
    else \
        pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt; \
    fi


FROM python:3.12.6-alpine

WORKDIR /app

RUN set -eux; \
    rm -rf /var/cache/apk/*

# Copy installed packages and binaries from builder stage
COPY --from=builder /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages
COPY --from=builder /usr/local/bin /usr/local/bin

COPY --from=builder /app /app

CMD ["gunicorn", "-w", "1", "-k", "uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker", "main:app", "--bind", "0.0.0.0"]
=== scripts ===
pre-commit.sh
start-server.sh
#!/bin/bash

# Start server
if [ "$1" = "-r" ]; then
    echo "Starting Development server with reload."
    exec uvicorn main:app --reload
else
    echo "Starting Production server."
    exec gunicorn -w 1 -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker main:app --bind=0.0.0.0
fi
